HEADLINE: Gautam Exim Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 5. To consider and approve the ....
MORE:
Gautam Exim Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 5. To consider and approve the Un-audited Standalone Financial Results of the company for the half year ended September 30, 2026.
6. To review and take on record the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors of the company on the financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026.
7. To review compliance with SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, specifically concerning BSE SME listing norms for the period ended September 30, 2026.
8. To authorize the Managing Director, Company Secretary, or Chief Financial Officer to sign, file, and submit the approved financial results and Limited Review Report to BSE Limited within the stipulated timeline.
9. To authorize publishing the financial results extract in newspapers as per regulatory requirements.
NEWSSUB: Board Meeting Intimation for Notice Of 06Th  /2026-27 Meeting Of The Board Of Directors Of Gautam Exim Limited For Half Yearly Results.
